strings.en: Take that, and that, and that!!
No time to dawdle! Let's make it quick!
I'll show you what the ART-1 can do!
This is no mere test type!
I'll show you what a Gespenst can do!
Don't you dare/　underestimate this Gespenst!
I'll show you the Grungust's power!
Don't think you can take on the Grungust/　and walk away unscathed!
I'll show you what a Hückebein can do!
Don't think you can stop me and the SRX!!
I won't lose to the Zeidram's power!
If it's a contest of power, that's my specialty too!
We're not doing this for fun, you hear?!
Like hell I'll let you get our friends!
Jua-Mu! We can't afford to/　lose to you guys either!
If you won't back off, then I'll/　put you out of your misery, Jua-Mu!
Let's settle this head-on, Al-Van Ranks!
Cheap tricks won't work on a Raftclans!/　I'm going all out!
Did it really have to come to this, Fu-Ruu...?!
You're a straight-up evil emperor, Gu-Landon!
For everything you've done.../　you're gonna pay, Gu-Landon!
What the hell are you guys here for now?!
The Balshem Series.../　What are you after?!
Picking a fight with us was your bad luck!
I'll blow way past your calculations!
That guy's the head of Golaikunru...?!
We're breaking through here no matter what!
You're not the one we're after!
Reggiane, get out of the way!
Herluga! We're not handing/　the Cross Gate over to you!
What is that guy, a theme park mascot...?!
Debudedabide, I won't let you do as you please!
I can't aim for the cockpit...!
Anyway, stopping it in its tracks comes first!
They can even control Zovorg machines?!
If nobody's aboard, I won't hold back!
If it's a Zovorg machine, there's no need to go easy!
Even the Yokijin are under their total control...!
First, I'll take apart your wings and tail!
Leave the dragon slaying to me!
I'll tear you apart, Skull Knight!
A dragon, a clown, and now a skull?!
You're the one who's disappearing here, XN-L!
God-ship or whatever you are,/　you're not getting past this point!
We've tangled with Zovorg units plenty of times!
As long as we're around,/　it's pointless to keep coming after Earth!
I'll kick you out of the Earth Sphere, Golaikunru!
We're not some merchandise for your business!
We'll be the ones taking you guys on!
An Org-Valu, huh? Can't let my guard down!
A Zeranio-class, huh?/　Gotta think about where to hit it!
Even if it's a new model!
If it's humanoid, there are plenty of ways to handle it!
Fury! I won't let you do as you please!
I'll make you realize Earth's got us defending it!
I'll take down that Thick Cylinder!
A Thick Cylinder! Stay right there!
Leave that Big Shoulder to me!
Having a horn doesn't make you strong!
A White Horn, huh? I'll take you on!
That standout body line.../　That's gotta be the commander!
I'll end this before it pulls any weird tricks!
The commander unit, huh!? Here I come!
Even against the Baran-Schneil,/　I'm not backing down a single step!
I'm surviving this, no matter what!
Don't think a Cupid can stop me!
Imperial guard or not, like hell I'll lose!
Damn new model, I won't let you get the Hagane!
If we don't beat them fast, Shinjuku's gonna...!
I'll crush them one by one, for sure!
Combining won't do you any good!
Combined or not, you're no match for us!
Looks like that don't scare me!
Who knew the Lamaris could get that huge!
Damn Lamaris Ida, I'll purify you!
I'll take out the Ida type fast!
I never thought that thing would come back...!
This is your last chance, Arieil!
I'll pay you back double for that!!
Don't think that was the end of it!
You want a fight? You got one!
I've got no intention of backing down!
Like hell I'll let you hit and run!
There's an order to these things, you know!
Gah!/　I-I'm not going down... not here!!
Ugh! I can still go! I can still fight!!
A-A pinch like this.../　I'll bust right through it!!
What?!/　But hey... a comeback from here/　is the classic super robot move!!
Aya, trust me! I'm not gonna lose!!
Heh, heh heh... Here it comes.../　the classic big pinch...!
I-In that case,/　let's show 'em our true Potential, R-1!
Waaah!/　The Gespenst's been pushed this far?!
What's wrong, Gespenst?!/　You can still go, right?!
Don't think this is all/　the Grungust's got!
D-Damn it!/　Even the Grungust can't cut it?!
If you're a Gespenst too, you can still keep going!
Don't underestimate this thing's staying power!
Don't think things'll go your way, Herluga!
Commander unit or not, I can't lose...!
Guh, I didn't think a Kaana would be this powerful...!
That thing didn't just get bigger...!
Tch! Stay out of my way!!
Ngh, nice attack.../　I'll be taking notes!
Gah!/　I won't forget your face!
Waaah, I'm hit!!/　...Eh, it's nothing to panic over.
This guy... he's dead set/　on stopping me...! Well, guess what!
Th-This is bad.../　Captain Viletta's gonna chew me out!
That's not enough to stop the SRX!!
Ngh! The Plus Parts took a hit!
I know! I just got careless for a sec!
Do I look like I'm slacking off?!/　Huh, I do?
Ugh!/　Aya, field support for the legs!
Like the R-1's gonna go down to this!!
Don't think the R-1 goes down that easy!
Damage check!/　Okay, R-1... we can still go!
Heh,/　looks like you underestimated the Gespenst!
Tch...!/　Where'd you get hit, Gespenst!?
That's the Grungust for you!/　It can take a direct hit, no sweat!
Not bad.../　Going toe-to-toe with a Grungust!
Tch, it's latched onto/　the R-Blade!
Your drive won't beat mine, Jua-Mu!
So every range is Al-Van's range...!
Tch! So that Emperor Unit's the real deal!
Vort read my moves ahead of time!
Ugh! I gotta move that thing outta there...!
I can't let that thing possess me!
Is that all your tricks, Debudedabide?!
Kuh! This fight isn't over yet,/　Skull Knight!
You're the one getting shattered,/　Crystal Dragoon!
XN-L, I'll show you what we humans are made of!
It's not like I got careless just because/　I'm used to fighting these guys, but...!
Kh! Like hell I'll let the Fury do whatever they want!
Damn it, I won't let Thorn overpower me!
Tch, I still can't read their moves!
Kh, I can't let a Kaana type give me trouble!
It's powered up, just like it looks...!
What, that's all you can dish out?
Th-This thing...!! It's way too weak...!
Tch, not bad!/　I'll call that your handicap!
So this is the folly of youth.../　No, this is no time to act cool!
Ow! Guess I didn't dodge that one...!
Where'd I get hit!?/　...Huh, just a scratch on the armor.
Dammit, I got distracted by/　their machine and took a hit.
Huh? I thought I dodged that...
Th-This is bad! At this rate,/　Captain Viletta's gonna drill me again!
Hey, were you looking the other way?
Shut up!/　I'm watching where I'm going!!
Looks like you failed to evade...
My bad!/　Let's pretend that never happened!
Damage to the SRX is minimal. No problem.
An invincible super robot/　isn't going down that easy!
Ryu,/　you can count on the field!
You scratched my R-1...!/　I won't forgive you!
You're ten years too early/　to take on the R-1!
Dammit.../　My R-1 got scratched again!
Don't think that's enough/　to stop the ART-1!
Ugh! If anything happens to this thing,/　Rob and the others'll chew me out.
Like that'll work/　on a Gespenst!
Don't make me laugh!/　Like that'd stop this Gespenst!
The Grungust's armor isn't just for show!
You'll need more power than that/　to punch through the Grungust's armor!
Tch! That won't stop the R-Blade!
How dare you scratch/　my R-Blade!
Whoa! And this is a new-model Gespenst!
Is that all you've got, Jua-Mu?!
Al-Van, you've got some good moves!
The Raftclans sure isn't easy to deal with...!
That's nowhere near a direct hit, Gomoudokka!
Being red doesn't make you fast, y'know!
Skull Knight's faster than I thought!
Like hell I'll let something like that wipe us out, XN-L!
Tch, did they tweak it a little?!
You never let your guard down/　against the Commander's unit!
Well, at least it took the bait!
Kh, Thorn's got its teeth in me!
Getting bigger won't let you win!
That thing's moving better than before!
It moves pretty well for its size!
You're a hundred years too early!
Whoa!? ...That was close, way too close.
So close! That was really close!
We didn't make it through all those/　fierce battles for nothing!
You're ten years too early/　to fight a Gespenst, too!
You're ten years too early/　to fight a Grungust, too!
Come back when you're ready, So-Des!
Your moves are easy to read, Jua-Mu!
Cheap tricks won't work on me, Karo-Ran!
I'll make you an emperor with no clothes, Gu-Landon!
I'm not falling for that, Iradoya!
I knew you'd do that, Vort!
Just dodging won't beat the Floraga...!
This feeling... I know it from somewhere...!
I won't lose to a puppet!
Is that all a deity ship's got?!
I've already got your attack patterns figured out!
Come on, aim for us some more!
You won't find an opening, Thorn!
I gotta take care of those guys fast...!
I can't let the Lamaris catch me.
Begone, demon! Or something like that!
Getting hugged by a monster isn't my idea of fun!
I've already seen through your attacks!
Even Rai could dodge something like that!
Go wash your face and try again!!
Rai, did you see that!?/　...Guess not, huh.
All right! That's the result of/　Captain Viletta's special training!
With Akimi watching,/　I can't make a fool of myself.
Your evasion pattern is full of waste.
Let's just call it a win, okay!?
That pattern was no good./　They'll hit me next time.
Ngh...!/　Was that evasion pattern about a 60!?
I see... Huh? Wait, was that a compliment?
Is that all the speed you've got, Skull Knight?!
After the last war, I'm used to/　fighting monsters!
Useless! You're a thousand years too early!!
Crap! I forgot to check the meter!
No fair! I can't reach you up there!
C'mon, c'mon! I'm not done yet!!
Time to let 'em have another one!
All right! I'll lend a hand too!!
This is Ryusei! I've got you covered!!
If you thought that last one finished me, think again!
Aya, leave the rest to me!
Let's go with Formation D, Aya!
Nice, Captain...! I can't fall behind!
Mai, I'll take it from here!
All right! Leave the rest to me, Latune!
Bullet! Leave the rest to me!
Kusuha, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Irm, I've got your back!
Masaki, leave the rest to me!
Yuuki, I'll take it from here!
I'll lend you a hand, Arado!
I'm going in too, Lieutenant Kyosuke!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Excellen, I've got your back!
Lieutenant Hugo, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend a hand, Lieutenant Aqua!
Touma, leave the rest to me!
Michiru, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend you a hand, Touya!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll back you up!
Akemi, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I'll take the hit! Hurry, get away!
Hold it right there!/　Heh, I'll take care of this one!
Let me do at least this much!
Aya, get out of here, quick!
Captain Viletta, get behind me, quick!
Latune! Get out of here while you can!
Latune! Leave that one to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, leave this to me!
Lieutenant Aqua, pull out of here!
Touya, I won't let them get you guys!
Moving in to cover Lieutenant Calvina!
I'm not letting this chance slip!
Take this, take this, take thiiiis!!
Take this! Special Move!!/　T-Link Knuckle!!
One blow to smash! Iron-fist justice!!
Heaven and Earth!/　Telekinetic Shattering Sword!!
Will of destruction... become my blade!!
You two, we're going with R-Formation!
Heaven and Earth... T-Link! Shattering Sword!!
System connect! Captain, leave the rest to me!
I'll leave it to you, Aya.
T-Link Full Contact!/　Metal Genocider Mode, activate!
System connect...! Mai, here we go!
Got it, Aya...!/　T-Link Twin Contact!
I'll show you the ART-1's super combo!
Try taking my secret combo move!
Mai, let's go with the/　T-Link Continuous Attack Fist!
All right! Let's keep it going!!
Guess I've got no choice but to use this!
Pierce, iron fist! Drill Boost Knuckle!!
Soar through the sky, wings of the shrike!
I'm gonna nail you,/　Split Missile!!
Take this! The thunder of justice!
I'll blow a hole right through your gut!
Old Iron's ultimate!/　Final Joker Card!
Take this! And this! And this!!
Take this, and this, and this, and THIS!!
Here's the Super Fighter's killer sword!
Let's end this!/　Super Fighter Ultimate Move!
A move straight out of the SRX!
I'll show you the Boxer's ultimate move!
I'll show you Type Haken's ultimate secret art!
C'mon, show me your Super Machine Wars.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Take this, iron fist! Boost Knuuuckle!!
I'll show you the Type-2's secret art!
I'll show you Cylion's special move!
